params.desc: The font name and font orientation to use. Font names are either a capital letter (A-Z) or a number (0-9). params.desc: The type of GS1 DataBar barcode to generate. Valid values are 1 (GS1 DataBar Omnidirectional), 2 (GS1 DataBar Truncated), 3 (GS1 DataBar Stacked), 4 (GS1 DataBar Stacked Omnidirectional), 5 (GS1 DataBar Limited), 6 (GS1 DataBar Expanded), 7 (UPC-A), 8 (UPC-E), 9 (EAN-13), 10 (EAN-8), 11 (GS1-128 + CC-A/CC-B) and 12 (GS1-128 + CC-C). The default value is 1 (GS1 DataBar Omnidirectional).

params.name: magnification
params.desc: The barcode magnification to use. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value depends on the print density being used.

params.name: sepHeight
params.desc: The height of the separator between the linear component and the 2D component. May be 1 or 2. The default value is 1.

params.name: height
params.desc: The barcode height of the linear component, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 25.

params.name: segWidth
params.desc: The segment width, for GS1 DataBar Expanded Stacked Omnidirectional barcodes (a type 6 variant). Any number between 2 and 20 may be used. There is no default value.

~BR.desc: Simulates colored label stock by drawing a colored rectangle on the label background. A ~BR command without any parameters clears any previously registered background rectangles. This is a Labelary-specific ZPL extension.

params.name: x
params.desc: The rectangle position x-coordinate, in dots. Any number between 0 and the label width may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: y
params.desc: The rectangle position y-coordinate, in dots. Any number between 0 and the label height may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: width
params.desc: The width of the rectangle, in dots. Any number between 1 and the label width may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: height
params.desc: The height of the rectangle, in dots. Any number between 1 and the label height may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: r
params.desc: The R (red) component of the rectangle color. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: g
params.desc: The G (green) component of the rectangle color. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: b
params.desc: The B (blue) component of the rectangle color. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is 0.

^BS.desc: Configures the current field as a UPC/EAN extension.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The barcode orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).

params.name: height
params.desc: The barcode height, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the barcode height configured via the ^BY command, which itself defaults to 10.

params.name: line
params.desc: Whether or not to include human-readable text with the barcode. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is Y (include human-readable text).

params.name: lineAbove
params.desc: Whether or not to place the human-readable text above the barcode. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is Y (if printed, text is placed above the barcode).

^BT.desc: Configures the current field as a TLC 39 barcode. Note that TLC 39 is not recommended for use in new applications.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The barcode orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).

params.name: width
params.desc: The Code 39 module width, in dots. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value depends on the print density of the printer.

params.name: widthRatio
params.desc: The Code 39 ratio between wide bars and narrow bars. Any decimal number between 2 and 3 may be used. The number must be a multiple of 0.1 (i.e. 2.0, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, ... , 2.9, 3.0). The default value is 2.

params.name: height
params.desc: The Code 39 barcode height, in dots. Any number between 1 and 9,999 may be used. The default value depends on the print density of the printer.

params.name: pdfWidth
params.desc: The MicroPDF417 module width, in dots. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value depends on the print density of the printer.

params.name: pdfHeight
params.desc: The MicroPDF417 row height, in dots. Any number between 1 and 255 may be used. The default value depends on the print density of the printer.

^BU.desc: Configures the current field as a UPC-A barcode.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The barcode orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).

params.name: height
params.desc: The barcode height, in dots. Any number between 1 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is the barcode height configured via the ^BY command, which itself defaults to 10.

params.name: line
params.desc: Whether or not to include human-readable text with the barcode. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is Y (include human-readable text).

params.name: lineAbove
params.desc: Whether or not to place the human-readable text above the barcode. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (if printed, text is placed below the barcode).

params.name: checkDigit
params.desc: Whether or not to show the check digit in the human-readable text. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is Y (show check digit).

^BX.desc: Configures the current field as a Data Matrix barcode.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The barcode orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).

params.name: height
params.desc: The barcode element height, in dots. The individual elements are square, so the element height and width will be the same. Any number between 1 and the label width may be used. The default value is the element height necessary for the total barcode height to match the barcode height configured via the ^BY command.

params.name: quality
params.desc: The level of error correction to apply. Valid values are 0 (ECC 0), 50 (ECC 50), 80 (ECC 80), 100 (ECC 100), 140 (ECC 140) and 200 (ECC 200). The default value is 0 (scan errors are detected but not corrected). Always use quality level 200 (ECC 200).

params.name: columns
params.desc: The number of columns to encode. This parameter can be used to control the barcode width. See valid ECC 200 column counts below. The default value depends on the amount of data encoded, as well as the aspect ratio selected.

params.name: rows
params.desc: The number of rows to encode. This parameter can be used to control the barcode height. See valid ECC 200 row counts below. The default value depends on the amount of data encoded, as well as the aspect ratio selected.

params.name: format
params.desc: The type of data that needs to be encoded. Valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. The default value is 6. This parameter is ignored for ECC 200 barcodes (the recommended quality level).

params.name: escape
params.desc: The escape character used to escape control sequences in the field data. The default value is "~" (tilde).

params.name: ratio
params.desc: The desired aspect ratio, if any. Valid values are 1 (square) and 2 (rectangular). The default value is 1 (square). Valid square sizes for ECC 200 are 10x10, 12x12, 14x14, 16x16, 18x18, 20x20, 22x22, 24x24, 26x26, 32x32, 36x36, 40x40, 44x44, 48x48, 52x52, 64x64, 72x72, 80x80, 88x88, 96x96, 104x104, 120x120, 132x132 and 144x144. Valid rectangular sizes for ECC 200 are 8x18, 8x32, 12x26, 12x36, 16x36 and 16x48.

params.name: width
params.desc: The default barcode module width, in dots. Any number between 1 and 100 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 2 if no value was previously configured.

params.name: widthRatio
params.desc: The default ratio between wide bars and narrow bars. Any decimal number between 2 and 3 may be used. The number must be a multiple of 0.1 (i.e. 2.0, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, ... , 2.9, 3.0). Larger numbers generally result in fewer barcode scan failures. The default value is the previously configured value, or 3 if no value was previously configured.

params.name: height
params.desc: The default barcode height, in dots. Any positive number may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 10 if no value was previously configured.

^BZ.desc: Configures the current field as a USPS postal barcode. Note that USPS POSTNET and USPS PLANET are not recommended for use in new applications.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The barcode orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).

params.name: height
params.desc: The barcode height, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the barcode height configured via the ^BY command, which itself defaults to 10.

params.name: line
params.desc: Whether or not to include human-readable text with the barcode. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (do not include human-readable text).

params.name: lineAbove
params.desc: Whether or not to place the human-readable text above the barcode. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (if printed, text is placed below the barcode).

params.name: type
params.desc: The type of postal barcode to generate. Valid values are 0 (POSTNET barcode), 1 (PLANET barcode) and 3 (USPS Intelligent Mail barcode). The default value is 0 (POSTNET barcode).

^CC.desc: Changes the caret character, which is used to start most commands.

params.name: caret
params.desc: The new caret character. Any ASCII character may be used. The default value is '^' (caret).

~CC.desc: Changes the caret character, which is used to start most commands.

params.name: caret
params.desc: The new caret character. Any ASCII character may be used. The default value is '^' (caret).

params.name: delim
params.desc: The new parameter delimiter. Any ASCII character may be used. The default value is ',' (comma).

params.name: delim
params.desc: The new parameter delimiter. Any ASCII character may be used. The default value is ',' (comma).

^CF.desc: Sets the default font. The default font is used by all subsequent text fields which do not specify a font using the ^A or ^A@ commands.

params.name: fontName
params.desc: The name of the new default font. Font names are either a capital letter (A-Z) or a number (0-9). The default value is the previously configured value, or A if no value was previously configured.

params.name: height
params.desc: The height of the new default font, in dots. The default value depends on the font selected.

params.name: width
params.desc: The width of the new default font, in dots. The default value depends on the font selected.

params.name: charset
params.desc: The character set to use. Any number between 0 and 36 may be used. The default value is 0 (Code Page 850). It is recommended that you always use value 28 (UTF-8).

params.name: customMappings
params.desc: Optional custom character mappings, specified as pairs of integers. Any numbers between 0 and 255 may be used. This parameter only affects Code Page 850 variants (charset values 0 - 13).

^CM.desc: Changes the memory device letter designations.

params.name: bAlias
params.desc: The new alias for the B: device. Valid values are B, E, R and A. The default value is B.

params.name: eAlias
params.desc: The new alias for the E: device. Valid values are B, E, R and A. The default value is E.

params.name: rAlias
params.desc: The new alias for the R: device. Valid values are B, E, R and A. The default value is R.

params.name: aAlias
params.desc: The new alias for the A: device. Valid values are B, E, R and A. The default value is A.

params.name: multiple
params.desc: Flag which, when set to the value M, allows E to be mapped to more than one device. There is no default value.

^CN.desc: Cycles the media cutter when in kiosk mode.

params.name: override
params.desc: Whether to use the default kiosk cut amount (from the ^KV command), or perform a full cut. Valid values are 0 (use the default cut amount) and 1 (perform a full cut). There is no default value.

^CO.desc: Configures the glyph cache, which is used internally to improve print speed when the same scalable font glyphs are used repeatedly. Note that this command is not needed in new applications, because printers manage the glyph cache automatically.

params.name: on
params.desc: Whether or not the glyph cache is enabled. Valid values are Y (cache on) and N (cache off). The default value is Y (cache on).

params.name: kilobytes
params.desc: The amount of extra memory to allocate to the glyph cache, in kilobytes. Any number between 1 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 40 kilobytes.

params.name: type
params.desc: The type of glyph cache being configured. Valid values are 0 (external cache recommended for regular fonts) and 1 (internal cache recommended for Asian fonts). The default value is 0 (external cache recommended for regular fonts).

^CP.desc: Removes a printed label from the presenter area.

params.name: mode
params.desc: The label removal mode. Valid values are 0 (eject label), 1 (retract label), and 2 (use the mode specified via the ^KV command). There is no default value.

^CT.desc: Changes the tilde character, which is used to start control commands.

params.name: tilde
params.desc: The new tilde character. Any ASCII character may be used. The default value is '~' (tilde).

~CT.desc: Changes the tilde character, which is used to start control commands.

params.name: tilde
params.desc: The new tilde character. Any ASCII character may be used. The default value is '~' (tilde).

^CV.desc: Configures barcode data validation. By default ZPL is very lenient about barcode data errors, but this command can be used to enable stricter checks.

params.name: validate
params.desc: Whether or not to more strictly validate barcode data. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (no strict validation).

^CW.desc: Configures a font name alias, so that a particular font file can later be used by font name via the ^A and ^CF commands.

params.name: fontName
params.desc: The font name to use for the specified font file. Font names are either a capital letter (A-Z) or a number (0-9). There is no default value. If no value is specified, the command is ignored.

params.name: path
params.desc: The font file path that the specified font name should alias to. Any valid font path may be used. There is no default value. If the specified font file does not exist, the command is ignored.

~DB.desc: Uploads an embedded bitmap font, storing it at the specified file path. Note that bitmap fonts are not recommended for use in new applications.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the bitmap font to. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.FNT.

params.name: orient
params.desc: The font orientation. This parameter is ignored, and defaults to normal horizontal orientation.

params.name: height
params.desc: The maximum glyph height, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: width
params.desc: The maximum glyph width, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: ascent
params.desc: The maximum glyph ascent, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: space
params.desc: The space character width, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: glyphs
params.desc: The number of glyphs in the font. Any number between 1 and 256 may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: copyright
params.desc: The font copyright holder. The maximum length is 63 characters. There is no default value.

params.name: data
params.desc: The font glyph data, as a series of (character code + height + width + x-offset + y-offset + advance + bitmap data) sequences. There is no default value.

~DE.desc: Uploads a custom encoding table, storing it at the specified file path. Note that custom encoding tables are not recommended for use in new applications.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the encoding table to. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.DAT.

params.name: size
params.desc: The size of the encoding table, in bytes. There is no default value.

params.name: data
params.desc: The encoding table data, as a string of hexadecimal values. There is no default value.

^DF.desc: Saves the remainder of the label definition to a file for later use via ^XF.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the label definition to. The ^XF command can later be used to load the label definition from this path. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.ZPL.

~DG.desc: Uploads an embedded image, storing it at the specified file path.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the image to. The ^XG command can later be used to load the image from this path. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

params.name: totalBytes
params.desc: The total number of bytes in the image. Because each pixel in the image uses 1 bit, this value should be the total number of pixels in the image, divided by 8 (since there are 8 bits per byte). There is no default value.

params.name: rowBytes
params.desc: The number of bytes per pixel row in the image. Because each pixel in the image uses 1 bit, this value should be the pixel width of the image, divided by 8 (since there are 8 bits per byte). The default value is 1, which is almost always incorrect.

params.name: data
params.desc: The image data, in hexadecimal format. There is no default value.

~DS.desc: Uploads an embedded scalable font, storing it at the specified file path. Note that most modern fonts should be uploaded using the ~DU command, rather than the ~DS command.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the font to. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.FNT.

params.name: size
params.desc: The total number of bytes in the font file. There is no default value.

params.name: data
params.desc: The font data, in hexadecimal format. There is no default value.

~DT.desc: Uploads an embedded TrueType font, storing it at the specified file path. Note that most modern fonts should be uploaded using the ~DU command, rather than the ~DT command.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the font to. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.FNT.

params.name: size
params.desc: The total number of bytes in the font file. There is no default value.

params.name: data
params.desc: The font data, in hexadecimal format. There is no default value.

~DU.desc: Uploads an embedded TrueType font, storing it at the specified file path.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the font to. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.FNT.

params.name: size
params.desc: The total number of bytes in the font file. There is no default value.

params.name: data
params.desc: The font data, in hexadecimal format. There is no default value.

~DY.desc: Uploads an embedded file, storing it at the specified file path. This command is most commonly used to upload images and fonts, although other file types can be uploaded as well. Because of the variety of supported file types, this command is fairly complex. It is recommended that the ~DU command be used instead when uploading fonts, and that the ~DG command be used instead when uploading images.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the file to. The file extension should be omitted, since it is determined based on the third (extension) parameter. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.

params.name: format
params.desc: The format of the data contained in the sixth parameter. Valid values are A (hexadecimal format), B (raw binary format), C (AR compressed), and P (hexadecimal format PNG data). There is no default value.

params.name: extension
params.desc: The file type to expect and the file name extension to use. There are many possible values, but some of the most common are G (GRF file), T (TTF file), and P (PNG file). The default value is G (GRF file).

params.name: totalBytes
params.desc: The total number of bytes in the file. There is no default value.

params.name: rowBytes
params.desc: The number of bytes per pixel row in the image, if the file is an image. This parameter is ignored if the extension parameter is not G (the file is not a GRF file). There is no default value.

params.name: data
params.desc: The file data, in the format specified in the second parameter. There is no default value.

^EG.desc: Erases all GRF image files from all writeable devices. Note that the ^ID command should be used instead, if possible.

~EG.desc: Erases all GRF image files from all writeable devices. Note that the ^ID command should be used instead, if possible.

^FB.desc: Formats the current field as a text block which wraps text across multiple lines.

params.name: maxWidth
params.desc: The maximum text block width, in dots. Text longer than this width is wrapped to another line. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0, which is rarely useful.

params.name: maxLines
params.desc: The maximum number of text lines to allow. If the text does not fit on the specified number of lines, any remaining text is drawn over the previous text on the last line. Any number between 1 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: lineSpacing
params.desc: Extra spacing to add between lines, in dots. Positive numbers increase the distance between lines, while negative numbers decrease the distance between lines. Any number between -9,999 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: alignment
params.desc: The text alignment to apply to the text block. Valid values are L (left), R (right), C (center) and J (justified). The default value is L (left).

params.name: hangingIndent
params.desc: The hanging indent to apply to all lines except the first line, in dots. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

^FC.desc: Configures the clock value escape character(s), allowing the current field to embed dynamic time values in the field data. Note that this command requires that the printer or print engine have access to real-time clock hardware, which not all physical printers include.

params.name: indicator1
params.desc: The escape character to use for primary clock time values. Any ASCII character may be used. The default value is '%' (percent).

params.name: indicator2
params.desc: The escape character to use for secondary clock time values. Any ASCII character may be used, except for the values used for the other two parameters. There is no default value.

params.name: indicator3
params.desc: The escape character to use for tertiary clock time values. Any ASCII character may be used, except for the values used for the other two parameters. There is no default value.

^FD.desc: Sets the current field's data string. This data is usually printed to the label as text or encoded as a barcode, depending on the field type.

params.name: data
params.desc: The data string. There is no default value.

^FE.desc: Configures the field data embed character, which allows the current field to embed field data from other fields which are numbered using the ^FN command. For example, if the embed character is set to #, then the text #3# can be used as a placeholder for the field data from field number 3, or the text #2,F,1,5# can be used as a placeholder for the first 5 characters of the field data from field 2, or the text #4,B,3,3# can be used as a placeholder for the last 3 characters of the field data from field 4.

params.name: embedChar
params.desc: The field data embed character, used to embed external field data into the current field. Any ASCII character may be used, except the ZPL command and parameter delimiters. The default value is '#' (hash).

^FH.desc: Configures the hexadecimal escape character, allowing the current field to embed character codes in the field data. This can be particularly useful when field data values may contain characters which would otherwise be interpreted as ZPL command or parameter delimiters.

params.name: hexIndicator
params.desc: The hexadecimal escape character. Any ASCII character may be used, except the lowercase letters a-z and the ZPL command and parameter delimiters. The default value is "_" (underscore).

^FL.desc: Links (or unlinks) one font to another, allowing the font engine to fall back from one font to another when a font is missing the glyph needed to render a character.

params.name: extensionPath
params.desc: The extension font file path. The font engine will fall back to this font if it encounters a missing glyph in the base font. There is no default value.

params.name: basePath
params.desc: The base font file path. If the font engine encounters a missing glyph in this font, it will fall back to the extension font. There is no default value.

params.name: link
params.desc: Whether to link or unlink the fonts. Valid values are 0 (unlink) and 1 (link). The default value is 0 (unlink).

^FM.desc: When used in conjunction with ^B7 or ^BF, this command configures multiple barcode positions for the current field, allowing the field data to be split across multiple barcodes using structured append.

params.name: positions
params.desc: Barcode positions, in dots, specified as pairs of integers (x and y values). Any numbers between 0 and 32,000 may be used. There are no default values.

^FN.desc: Sets the current field's field number. When using the ^DF command to save label definitions for later use, the ^FN command is used to define the field numbers available for later reference. When using the ^XF command to load previously saved label definitions, the ^FN command is used to reference the field numbers previously defined.

params.name: fieldNumber
params.desc: The current field's field number. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

^FO.desc: Sets the position of the top left corner of the current field.

params.name: x
params.desc: The field position x-coordinate, in dots. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: y
params.desc: The field position y-coordinate, in dots. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: alignment
params.desc: The origin alignment to use. Valid values are 0 (left alignment), 1 (right alignment), and 2 (automatic alignment based on the direction of the field data text). The default value is the value previously configured via the ^FW command, if any.

^FP.desc: Configures the current field's print direction.

params.name: direction
params.desc: The print direction. Valid values are H (horizontal / left to right), V (vertical / top to bottom), and R (reverse / right to left). The default value is H (horizontal / left to right).

params.name: characterSpacing
params.desc: Extra spacing to add between characters, in dots. Positive numbers increase the distance between characters, while negative numbers decrease the distance between characters. Any number between -10 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

^FR.desc: Configures the current field to reverse the background color, drawing black over white and white over black. This is also known as XOR mode drawing.

^FS.desc: Ends the current field and starts the next field.

^FT.desc: Sets the position of the bottom left corner of the current field.

params.name: x
params.desc: The field position x-coordinate, in dots. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the right edge of the previous field.

params.name: y
params.desc: The field position y-coordinate, in dots. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the bottom edge of the previous field.

params.name: alignment
params.desc: The origin alignment to use. Valid values are 0 (left alignment), 1 (right alignment), and 2 (automatic alignment based on the direction of the field data text). The default value is the value previously configured via the ^FW command, if any.

^FV.desc: Sets the current field's data string. This command is an alternative to the ^FD command, and allows the use of variable data when the ^MC command is used to retain rendered content across multiple labels.

params.name: data
params.desc: The data string. There is no default value.

^FW.desc: Sets the default field orientation and alignment.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The default field orientation. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is N (no rotation).

params.name: alignment
params.desc: The default field origin alignment. Valid values are 0 (left alignment), 1 (right alignment), and 2 (automatic alignment based on the direction of the field data text). The default value is 0 (left alignment).

^FX.desc: Adds a comment to the ZPL code. Comments do not affect the rendering of the label, and can be used to document assumptions, concepts or questions.

params.name: comment
params.desc: The informational comment. There is no default value.

^GB.desc: Configures the current field as a graphical box.

params.name: width
params.desc: The width of the box, in dots. Any number between the box line thickness and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the box line thickness.

params.name: height
params.desc: The height of the box, in dots. Any number between the box line thickness and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the box line thickness.

params.name: thickness
params.desc: The line thickness to use to draw the box, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: color
params.desc: The line color to use to draw the box. Valid values are B (black) and W (white). The default value is B (black).

params.name: rounding
params.desc: The amount of rounding to apply to the box corners. Any number between 0 (no rounding) and 8 (maximum rounding) may be used. The default value is 0 (no rounding).

^GC.desc: Configures the current field as a graphical circle.

params.name: diameter
params.desc: The diameter of the circle, in dots. Any number between 3 and 4,095 may be used. The default value is 3.

params.name: thickness
params.desc: The line thickness to use to draw the circle, in dots. Any number between 1 and 4,095 may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: color
params.desc: The line color to use to draw the circle. Valid values are B (black) and W (white). The default value is B (black).

^GD.desc: Configures the current field as a graphical diagonal line.

params.name: width
params.desc: The width of the rectangle which defines the diagonal line, in dots. Any number between 3 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the line thickness.

params.name: height
params.desc: The height of the rectangle which defines the diagonal line, in dots. Any number between 3 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the line thickness.

params.name: thickness
params.desc: The line thickness to use to draw the diagonal line, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: color
params.desc: The line color to use to draw the diagonal line. Valid values are B (black) and W (white). The default value is B (black).

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The direction of the diagonal line. Valid values are R (bottom to top) and L (top to bottom). The default value is R (bottom to top).

^GE.desc: Configures the current field as a graphical ellipse.

params.name: width
params.desc: The width of the ellipse, in dots. Any number between 3 and 4,095 may be used. The default value is 3.

params.name: height
params.desc: The height of the ellipse, in dots. Any number between 3 and 4,095 may be used. The default value is 3.

params.name: thickness
params.desc: The line thickness to use to draw the ellipse, in dots. Any number between 1 and 4,095 may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: color
params.desc: The line color to use to draw the ellipse. Valid values are B (black) and W (white). The default value is B (black).

^GF.desc: Configures the current field as an embedded image field.

params.name: format
params.desc: The format of the image data contained in the fifth parameter. Valid values are A (hexadecimal format), B (raw binary format), and C (AR compressed). There is no default value. Format A (hexadecimal format) causes the fewest compatibility issues.

params.name: dataBytes
params.desc: The total number of data bytes in the fifth parameter. The value of this parameter is always the same as totalBytes, except in the case of format C (AR compressed) which is very rarely used. There is no default value.

params.name: totalBytes
params.desc: The total number of bytes in the image. Because each pixel in the image uses 1 bit, this value should be the total number of pixels in the image, divided by 8 (since there are 8 bits per byte). There is no default value.

params.name: rowBytes
params.desc: The number of bytes per pixel row in the image. Because each pixel in the image uses 1 bit, this value should be the pixel width of the image, divided by 8 (since there are 8 bits per byte). There is no default value.

params.name: data
params.desc: The image data, in the format specified in the first parameter. There is no default value.

^GS.desc: Configures the current field as a graphical symbol, mapping ASCII values in the field data to non-ASCII symbols (A = ®, B = ©, C = ™, D = Underwriters Laboratories (UL) approval symbol, E = Canadian Standards Association approval symbol).

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The symbol orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).

params.name: height
params.desc: The symbol height to use, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the value previously configured via the ^CF command, if any.

params.name: width
params.desc: The symbol width to use, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the value previously configured via the ^CF command, if any.

~HB.desc: Requests a battery status report via the terminal.

~HD.desc: Requests a head diagnostic report via the terminal.

^HF.desc: Requests a label definition file via the terminal.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to read the label definition from. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.ZPL.

^HG.desc: Requests an image graphics file via the terminal.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to read the image graphics from. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

^HH.desc: Requests a full configuration report via the terminal.

~HI.desc: Requests a basic configuration report via the terminal.

^HL.desc: Requests the RFID data log via the terminal.

~HL.desc: Requests the RFID data log via the terminal.

~HM.desc: Requests a RAM status report via the terminal.

params.name: query
params.desc: The type of information being requested. Valid values are ES (error status), HA (internal wired print server hardware address), JT (printhead test results), MA (maintenance alert settings), MI (maintenance information), OD (odometer), PH (printhead history), PP (plug and play string), SN (serial number), and UI (USB product ID). There is no default value.

^HR.desc: Calibrates the RFID tag position and sends the results via the terminal.

params.name: prefix
params.desc: Prefix text to send via the terminal before sending the calibration results. The default value is 'start'.

params.name: suffix
params.desc: Suffix text to send via the terminal after sending the calibration results. The default value is 'end'.

params.name: start
params.desc: The initial calibration position, in millimeters, relative to the leading print edge. Valid values are F0 - F999 and B0 - B30, where the letters represent the direction (F = forwards, B = backwards). The default value is hardware-dependent.

params.name: end
params.desc: The final calibration position, in millimeters, relative to the leading print edge. Valid values are F0 - F999 and B0 - B30, where the letters represent the direction (F = forwards, B = backwards). The default value is hardware-dependent.

params.name: antennaSelection
params.desc: Whether the RFID antenna selection should be manual or automatic. Valid values are M (manual) and A (automatic). The default value is A (automatic).

~HS.desc: Requests a hardware status report via the terminal.

^HT.desc: Requests a list of font links via the terminal.

~HU.desc: Requests an alert configuration report via the terminal.

^HV.desc: Requests the field data associated with a specific field via the terminal.

params.name: fieldNumber
params.desc: The number identifying the field whose field data is being requested. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: bytes
params.desc: The number of bytes of data being requested. Any number between 1 and 256 may be specified. The default value is 64.

params.name: prefix
params.desc: Custom prefix to send via the terminal before sending the field data. There is no default value.

params.name: suffix
params.desc: Custom suffix to send via the terminal after sending the field data. There is no default value.

params.name: mode
params.desc: Whether to send field data for each label definition processed, or for each label generated. Valid values are F (per label definition) and L (per label generated). The default value is F (per label definition).

^HW.desc: Requests a file listing via the terminal.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path pattern used to search for files to include in the file listing. Wildcards (*, ?) are accepted. The default value is R:*.* which includes all files on the R drive.

params.name: format
params.desc: The format to use to send the file listing. Valid values are D (default) and C (columns). The default value is D (default).

^HY.desc: Requests an image graphics file via the terminal.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to read the image graphics from. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

^HZ.desc: Requests printer information in XML format via the terminal.

params.name: selector
params.desc: The type of information to be sent. Valid values are A (all information), F (format configuration), L (directory listing), O (individual object information) and R (printer status). There is no default value.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path of the individual object whose information is being requested. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF. Used only when requesting individual object information (selector = O).

params.name: longFilenames
params.desc: Whether or not to use long (16 character) filenames. Valid values are N (no, use 8 characters) and Y (yes, use 16 characters). The default value is N (no, use 8 characters). Used only when requesting individual object information (selector = O).

^ID.desc: Deletes a file or set of files from printer memory.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path pattern used to search for files to delete. Wildcards (*, ?) are accepted. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

^IL.desc: Configures the current field as a label image field. The label image file is usually previously saved to memory using the ^IS command.

params.name: path
params.desc: The path to the label image file. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

^IM.desc: Configures the current field as an image graphics field.

params.name: path
params.desc: The path to the image graphics file. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

^IS.desc: Saves the current label definition to an image file for later use via ^IL.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to save the image to. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

params.name: print
params.desc: Whether or not to continue printing the current label definition after saving it as an image file. Valid values are Y (print after saving) and N (do not print after saving). The default value is Y (print after saving).

~JA.desc: Cancels the current print job, as well as any label definitions currently in the buffer waiting to be printed.

^JB.desc: Reinitializes a flash memory device installed in the printer.

params.name: device
params.desc: The device to be reinitialized. Valid values are A (Compact Flash card), B (PCMCIA card) and E (internal flash memory). There is no default value.

~JB.desc: Reinitializes the PCMCIA card installed in the printer (i.e. the B: drive). If you need to reinitialize any other flash memory devices, see the ^JB command instead.

~JC.desc: Recalibrates the label length and sensor settings.

~JD.desc: Enables diagnostic mode. While diagnostic mode is enabled, the byte values received by the printer are rendered to diagnostic labels, rather than interpreted as ZPL. Diagnostic mode is useful to debug communications and encoding issues. Diagnostic mode can be disabled with the ~JE command.

~JE.desc: Disables diagnostic mode (previously enabled with the ~JD command).

~JF.desc: Configures whether or not the printer pauses printing when the printer battery has very low power, in order to avoid data loss.

params.name: pause
params.desc: Whether or not to pause when the printer battery has very low power. Valid values are Y (pause on low power) and N (do not pause on low power). The default value is Y (pause on low power).

~JG.desc: Prints a sensor calibration graph label. The graph displays the values set by the ~JC or ^SS commands.

^JH.desc: Configures the early warning settings for the printer.

params.name: warnMedia
params.desc: Enable or disable media-related warnings. Valid values are E (enable) and D (disable). The default value is D (disable).

params.name: mediaLength
params.desc: The number of labels per label roll. Any number between 100 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 900.

params.name: mediaReplaced
params.desc: Whether or not the label roll has been replaced. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (labels have not been replaced).

params.name: ribbonLength
params.desc: The length of the ribbon. Valid values vary by printer model, as does the default value.

params.name: ribbonReplaced
params.desc: Whether or not the ribbon has been replaced. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (ribbon has not been replaced).

params.name: warnMaintenance
params.desc: Enable or disable hardware maintenance-related warnings. Valid values are E (enable) and D (disable). The default value is D (disable).

params.name: headCleanInterval
params.desc: The expected interval between printhead cleanings. Any number between 0 and 16 may be used, where number N represents an interval of (100+(50*N)) meters. The default value varies by printer model.

params.name: headCleaned
params.desc: Whether or not the printhead has been cleaned. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (printhead has not been cleaned).

params.name: headLifeInterval
params.desc: The expected interval between printhead replacements, in inches. Any number between 100 and 3,500,000 may be used. The default value is 1,000,000.

params.name: headReplaced
params.desc: Whether or not the printhead has been replaced. Valid values are Y and N. The default value is N (printhead has not been replaced).

^JI.desc: Starts a new ZBI (BASIC interpreter) session. The ZBI session can be ended with the ~JQ command.

params.name: script
params.desc: The path to the BASIC initialization script to run automatically, if any. There is no default value.

params.name: console
params.desc: Whether or not to enable the console. Valid values are Y (enable the console) and N (do not enable the console). The default value is Y (enable the console).

params.name: echo
params.desc: Whether or not to enable echoing. Valid values are Y (enable echoing) and N (do not enable echoing). The default value is Y (enable echoing).

~JI.desc: Starts a new ZBI (BASIC interpreter) session. The ZBI session can be ended with the ~JQ command.

^JJ.desc: Configures the auxiliary port, which is used to control verifier and applicator devices.

params.name: opMode
params.desc: The operational mode. Valid values are 0 (off), 1 (stop on error) and 2 (stop soon after error). The default value is 0 (off).

params.name: appMode
params.desc: The application mode. Valid values are 0 (off), 1 (signal low while printing), 2 (signal high while printing), 3 (signal low after printing) and 4 (signal high after printing). The default value is 0 (off).

params.name: signalMode
params.desc: The start print signal mode. Valid values are P (pulse mode) and L (level mode).

params.name: errMode
params.desc: The label error mode. Valid values are E (error mode) and F (feed mode). The default value is F (feed mode).

params.name: reprintMode
params.desc: The reprint mode. Valid values are E (enabled) and D (disabled). The default value is D (disabled).

params.name: ribbonMode
params.desc: The ribbon low warning mode. Valid values are E (enabled) and D (disabled). The default value is E (enabled).

~JK.desc: Cuts the label when the printer is in "delayed cut" print mode, which can be configured with the ^MM command. The ~JK command should be sent to the printer separately from any other commands.

^JM.desc: Halves the print density, effectively doubling the physical size of any label content.

params.name: adjustment
params.desc: Whether to use normal print density or half print density. Valid values are A (normal print density) and B (half print density). The default value is the previously configured value, or A (normal print density) if no value was previously configured.

~JN.desc: Starts a printhead test. The printer will halt if the test fails.

~JO.desc: Starts a printhead test. The printer will pause if the test fails.

~JP.desc: Cancels the currently-processing label definition (if any) and pauses printing.

~JQ.desc: Ends the current ZBI (BASIC interpreter) session, if one was previously started with a ^JI or ~JI command.

~JR.desc: Resets the printer, simulating a manual power cycle.

params.name: sensor
params.desc: The active media sensor. Valid values are A (auto-select), R (reflective media sensor) and T (transmissive media sensor). The default value varies by printer model.

params.name: sequence
params.desc: The label backfeed actions. Valid values are A (100% backfeed after printing), B (100% backfeed before printing), N (normal, i.e. 90% backfeed after printing), O (off, i.e. no backfeed), or any multiple of 10 between 10 and 90 (percent backfeed after printing). The default value is N (normal, i.e. 90% backfeed after printing).

params.name: interval
params.desc: The interval, in labels, between each printhead test. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0 (no test).

params.name: manual
params.desc: Whether or not to configure the test element range manually. Valid values are Y (manual configuration) and N (automatic configuration). The default value is N (automatic configuration).

params.name: first
params.desc: The first element to test (if manual is Y). Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: last
params.desc: The last element to test (if manual is Y). Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 9,999.

^JU.desc: Loads or saves the printer configuration.

params.name: configuration
params.desc: The printer configuration to load or save. Valid values are S (save current settings), R (reload last saved settings), F (reload factory settings) and N (reload factory network settings). There is no default value.

params.name: tension
params.desc: The ribbon tension. Valid values are L (low tension), M (medium tension) and H (high tension). There is no default value.

^JZ.desc: Configures whether or not to reprint labels which were interrupted by an error condition as soon as the error is corrected.

params.name: reprint
params.desc: Whether or not to reprint labels which were interrupted by an error condition. Valid values are Y (reprint) and N (do not reprint). There is no default value.

~KB.desc: Completely drains the rechargeable battery, if the printer has one.

^KC.desc: Enables and disables custom network client identifiers.

params.name: enable
params.desc: Whether or not to enable a custom network client identifier. Valid values are 0 (disable), 1 (enable and use the MAC address), 2 (enable and use the specified ASCII value) and 3 (enable and use the specified hexadecimal value). The default value is 0 (disable).

params.name: device
params.desc: The network device to configure. Valid values are 0 (all network devices), 1 (the wireless network device), 2 (the external wired network device) and 3 (the internal wired network device). The default value is 1 (the wireless network device).

params.name: prefix
params.desc: Optional prefix to use. May be up to 11 ASCII characters or 22 hexadecimal characters (representing 11 bytes), depending on the value of the first parameter. There is no default value.

params.name: identifier
params.desc: The client identifier to use. May be up to 60 ASCII characters or 120 hexadecimal characters (representing 60 bytes), depending on the value of the first parameter. There is no default value.

^KD.desc: Sets the date and time format used on control panels and configuration diagnostic labels.

params.name: format
params.desc: The date and time format to use. Valid values are 1 (mm/dd/yy with a 24-hour time), 2 (mm/dd/yy with a 12-hour time), 3 (dd/mm/yy with a 24-hour time) and 4 (dd/mm/yy with a 12-hour time). The default value is 1 (mm/dd/yy with a 24-hour time).

^KL.desc: Sets the control panel display language.

params.name: language
params.desc: The control panel display language. Valid values are 1 (English), 2 (Spanish), 3 (French), 4 (German), 5 (Italian), 6 (Norwegian), 7 (Portuguese), 8 (Swedish), 9 (Danish), 10 (Spanish), 11 (Dutch), 12 (Finnish), 13 (Japanese), 14 (Korean), 15 (Simplified Chinese), 16 (Traditional Chinese), 17 (Russian), 18 (Polish), 19 (Czech), and 20 (Romanian). The default value is 1 (English).

params.name: name
params.desc: The printer network name. The maximum length is 16 characters. The default value depends on the printer's MAC address.

params.name: description
params.desc: The printer description, if any. The maximum length is 35 characters. There is no default value.

params.name: password
params.desc: The new control panel password. Must be four digits. The default value is 1234.

params.name: level
params.desc: The password level. Any number between 1 and 4 may be used. The default value is 3.

^KV.desc: Sets various kiosk mode parameters. Kiosk mode can be enabled with the ^MM command.

params.name: cutAmount
params.desc: Amount to leave uncut, in millimeters. Any number between 10 and 60 may be used. The value 0 may also be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

params.name: cutMargin
params.desc: The cut margin, in millimeters. Any number between 2 and 9 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 9 if no value was previously configured.

params.name: presentType
params.desc: The present action type. Valid values are 0 (eject after printing), 1 (retract after printing) and 2 (no action). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (eject page) if no value was previously configured.

params.name: presentTimeout
params.desc: The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a label to be retrieved before retracting it. Any number between 0 and 300 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (no timeout) if no value was previously configured.

params.name: loopLen
params.desc: The presenter loop length, in millimeters. Any number between 3 and 1,023 may be used. The value 0 may also be used to indicate no loop. The default value is the previously configured value, or 400 if no value was previously configured.

^LF.desc: Generates a configuration label containing a list of font links. If the current label already contains content, the configuration label will be generated after the current label.

^LH.desc: Sets the label home position, which serves as the origin (0, 0) of the label coordinate system.

params.name: x
params.desc: The x-coordinate of the new origin, in dots, relative to the original origin (top left corner of the label). Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

params.name: y
params.desc: The y-coordinate of the new origin, in dots, relative to the original origin (top left corner of the label). Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

^LL.desc: Sets the label length (most commonly used with continuous media).

params.name: length
params.desc: The label length, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value depends on previous configuration.

params.name: allMedia
params.desc: Whether or not the label length applies to all media (Y) or only to continuous media (N). The default value is N (continuous media only).

^LR.desc: Configures all subsequent fields in the current label to reverse the background color, drawing black over white and white over black. This is also known as XOR mode drawing. This command is the global equivalent of the field-specific ^FR command.

params.name: reverse
params.desc: Whether or not to enable reverse mode. Valid values are Y (enable reverse mode) and N (disable reverse mode). The default value is N (disable reverse mode).

^LS.desc: Shifts all label content to the left or the right.

params.name: distance
params.desc: The distance to shift label content to the left, in dots. Any number between -9,999 and 9,999 may be used. Positive values shift label content to the left, while negative values shift label content to the right. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

^LT.desc: Shifts all label content up or down.

params.name: distance
params.desc: The distance to shift label content down, in dots. Any number between -120 and 120 may be used. Positive values shift label content down, while negative values shift label content up. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

^MA.desc: Configures the printing of maintenance alert labels. The alert messages can be configured using the ^MI command.

params.name: type
params.desc: The type of maintenance alert to configure. Valid values are R (printhead replacement alerts) and C (printhead cleaning alerts). There is no default value.

params.name: print
params.desc: Whether or not to print a maintenance alert label for the specified alert type. Valid values are Y (print alert labels) and N (do not print alert labels). The default value is N (do not print alert labels).

params.name: threshold
params.desc: The initial label distance after which the first maintenance alert label should be printed. For alert type R, any number between 0 and 150 may be used; units are kilometers. For alert type C, any number between 0 and 2,000 may be used; units are meters. The default value is 50 km for alert type R, and 0 m for alert type C. If set to 0, the selected alert is disabled.

params.name: frequency
params.desc: The label distance after which the maintenance alert label should reprint, in meters. Any number between 0 and 2,000 may be used. The default value is 0, which causes the selected alert to trigger only on power-up.

params.name: units
params.desc: The units to use when reporting maintenance information. Valid values are C (centimeters), I (inches) and M (meters). The default value is I (inches).

^MC.desc: Allows the previous label output to be kept as part of the next label.

params.name: clear
params.desc: Whether or not to clear the previous label contents before drawing the next label. Valid values are Y (clear the previous label contents) and N (do not clear the previous label contents). The default value is Y (clear the previous label contents).

^MD.desc: Modifies the print darkness level, relative to the base print darkness configured with the ~SD command.

params.name: darknessModifier
params.desc: The amount to increase or decrease the darkness level. Any number between -30 and 30 may be used. Negative numbers result in lighter print output, while positive numbers result in darker print output. There is no default value.

^MF.desc: Configures the power-up and head-close media feed actions.

params.name: powerupAction
params.desc: The media feed action to take on power-up. Valid values are F (feed media to first inter-label mark), C (recalibrate media sensor), L (reset the label length), N (do nothing), and S (perform a short calibration). The default value is C (recalibrate media sensor).

params.name: closingAction
params.desc: The media feed action to take on head-close. Valid values are F (feed media to first inter-label mark), C (recalibrate media sensor), L (reset the label length), N (do nothing), and S (perform a short calibration). The default value is C (recalibrate media sensor).

^MI.desc: Configures the messages used on the maintenance alert labels. The frequency of the maintenance alert labels can be configured using the ^MA command.

params.name: type
params.desc: The type of maintenance alert to configure. Valid values are R (printhead replacement alerts) and C (printhead cleaning alerts). The default value is R (printhead replacement alerts).

params.name: message
params.desc: The message to print on the maintenance alert label. The maximum length is 63 characters. The default value is "PLEASE REPLACE PRINT HEAD" for alert type R, and "PLEASE CLEAN PRINT HEAD" for alert type C.

params.name: maxLength
params.desc: The maximum label length, in dots. There is no default value.

params.name: mode
params.desc: The post-print action to be taken by the printer after each label is printed. Valid values are T (advance label to tear-off bar for manual tear-off), P (advance label and wait for manual peel-off), R (rewind label on an external rewind device), A (advance label for applicator device), C (advance label for automated cutting), D (wait for delayed cut command), F (encode RFID data without backfeed), and K (present label for removal from kiosk). The default value is T (advance label to tear-off bar for manual tear-off).

params.name: prepeel
params.desc: Whether or not to pre-peel each label before printing. Valid values are Y (pre-peel labels) and N (do not pre-peel labels). The default value is N (do not pre-peel labels).

params.name: media
params.desc: The label media type being used. Valid values are N (continuous media), V (variable-length continuous media), W or Y (non-continuous web-sensing media), M (non-continuous mark-sensing media), and A (auto-detect media type during calibration). There is no default value.

params.name: offset
params.desc: The offset of the media mark relative to the actual label break, in dots. Valid values are hardware-specific, but values between -75 and 283 are usually valid. The default value is 0.

^MP.desc: Enables and disables control panel functionality.

params.name: function
params.desc: The control panel function to be disabled. Valid values are D (disable darkness mode), P (disable position mode), C (disable calibration mode), W (disable pause), F (disable feed), X (disable cancel), M (disable menu adjustments), S (disable mode saves), and E (re-enable all modes). There is no default value.

params.name: mediaType
params.desc: The label media type being used. Valid values are D (direct thermal media) and T (thermal transfer media). There is no default value.

^MU.desc: Customizes the units of the label coordinate system, so that commands which normally accept coordinates and distances in dots may instead use physical units like millimeters and inches. This command also optionally allows DPI conversion of label definitions.

params.name: units
params.desc: The units to use to specify label coordinates and distances. Valid values are D (dots), I (inches), and M (millimeters). There is no default value.

params.name: baseDpi
params.desc: The label definition base DPI. This parameter is ignored if units are not D (dots). Valid values are 150, 200, 300 and 600. There is no default value.

params.name: desiredDpi
params.desc: The label definition desired DPI. This parameter is ignored if units are not D (dots). Valid values are 150, 200, 300 and 600. This value must be a whole-integer multiple of the base DPI. There is no default value.

^MW.desc: Enables and disables the head cold warning.

params.name: enable
params.desc: Whether or not to enable the head cold warning. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). There is no default value.

^NB.desc: Configures whether or not to prefer wired print servers over wireless print servers during network boot. Affects only printers with both wired and wireless print servers.

params.name: wired
params.desc: Whether or not to prefer wired print servers over wireless print servers during network boot. Valid values are C (check for, and prefer, wired print servers over wireless print servers) and S (skip wired print server check, and prefer wireless print servers). The default value is S (prefer wireless print servers).

params.name: device
params.desc: The primary network device. Valid values are 1 (wired) and 2 (wireless). The default value is 1 (wired).

~NC.desc: Connects to a specific network printer, based on the printer's three-digit network ID. The printer's network ID can be set using the ^NI command.

params.name: networkId
params.desc: The three-digit network ID of the printer to send the label definition to. Any number between 000 and 999 may be used. The default value is 000.

^ND.desc: Configures the network settings for a specific network device.

params.name: device
params.desc: The network device to configure. Valid values are 1 (external wired), 2 (internal wired) and 3 (wireless). There is no default value.

params.name: res
params.desc: The IP resolver to use. Valid values are A (all), B (BOOTP), C (DHCP and BOOTP), D (DHCP), G (gleaning), R (RARP) and P (permanent). The default value is A (all).

params.name: ip
params.desc: The IP address to use. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: mask
params.desc: The subnet mask to use. Any valid subnet mask in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: gateway
params.desc: The default network gateway. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: wins
params.desc: The WINS server IP address. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Whether or not to enable a connection timeout. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). The default value is Y (enable).

params.name: secs
params.desc: The network connection timeout, in seconds. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 300.

params.name: arp
params.desc: The ARP broadcast interval, in minutes. Any number between 0 and 30 may be used. The default value is 0 (no ARP broadcast).

params.name: port
params.desc: The port number to use for RAW data. Any number between 1 and 65,535 may be used. The default value is 9100.

^NI.desc: Sets the printer's three-digit network ID.

params.name: networkId
params.desc: The three-digit network ID to assign to the printer. Any number between 000 and 999 may be used. The default value is 000 (no network ID).

params.name: name
params.desc: The SNMP system name. The maximum length is 17 characters. There is no default value.

params.name: contact
params.desc: The SNMP system contact. The maximum length is 50 characters. There is no default value.

params.name: location
params.desc: The SNMP system location. The maximum length is 50 characters. There is no default value.

params.name: getCommunity
params.desc: The SNMP GET community name. The maximum length is 19 characters. The default value is 'public'.

params.name: setCommunity
params.desc: The SNMP SET community name. The maximum length is 19 characters. The default value is 'public'.

params.name: trapCommunity
params.desc: The SNMP TRAP community name. The maximum length is 20 characters. The default value is 'public'.

^NP.desc: Configures the source of the network settings used at start up.

params.name: device
params.desc: The device whose network settings are to be used at start up. Valid values are P (printer) and M (print server). The default value is P (printer).

~NR.desc: Configures all printers on the network to operate in transparent mode.

^NS.desc: Configures the network settings for the wired print server. Note that the ^ND command should be used instead, if possible.

params.name: res
params.desc: The IP resolver to use. Valid values are A (all), B (BOOTP), C (DHCP and BOOTP), D (DHCP), G (gleaning), R (RARP) and P (permanent). The default value is A (all).

params.name: ip
params.desc: The IP address to use. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: mask
params.desc: The subnet mask to use. Any valid subnet mask in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: gateway
params.desc: The default network gateway. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: wins
params.desc: The WINS server IP address. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Whether or not to enable a connection timeout. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). The default value is Y (enable).

params.name: secs
params.desc: The network connection timeout, in seconds. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 300.

params.name: arp
params.desc: The ARP broadcast interval, in minutes. Any number between 0 and 30 may be used. The default value is 0 (no ARP broadcast).

params.name: port
params.desc: The port number to use for RAW data. Any number between 1 and 65,535 may be used. The default value is 9100.

^NT.desc: Configures the printer's SMTP settings, which are used to send email alerts.

params.name: server
params.desc: The SMTP server's IP address, in dot-decimal notation. There is no default value.

params.name: domain
params.desc: The SMTP domain. Any valid domain name may be used. There is no default value.

~NT.desc: Configures the current printer to operate in network transparent mode.

^NW.desc: Sets the printer homepage authentication timeout, in minutes. This is the time after which the user is prompted again for the printer password.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: The number of minutes that a user's web authentication is valid. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is 5.

^PA.desc: Configures advanced text layout and font engine settings.

params.name: defaultGlyph
params.desc: Whether to use a space character or the .notdef glyph when a font is unable to display a character. The .notdef glyph is usually a blank vertical rectangle. Valid values are 0 (use a space character) and 1 (use the .notdef glyph). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (use a space character) if no value was previously configured.

params.name: bidi
params.desc: Whether or not to enable bidirectional text layout, which is important for Arabic and Hebrew scripts. Valid values are 0 (disable bidi layout) and 1 (enable bidi layout). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (disable bidi layout) if no value was previously configured.

params.name: charShaping
params.desc: Whether or not to enable character shaping, which is important for Arabic and Indic scripts. Valid values are 0 (disable character shaping) and 1 (enable character shaping). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (disable character shaping) if no value was previously configured.

params.name: openTypeSupport
params.desc: Whether or not to enable support for advanced OpenType font features, like ligatures. Valid values are 0 (disable OpenType features) and 1 (enable OpenType features). The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 (disable OpenType features) if no value was previously configured.

^PF.desc: Slews the label the specified number of dot rows, skipping all printing across those rows.

params.name: rows
params.desc: The number of dot rows (starting at the bottom of the label) to slew. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. There is no default value.

^PH.desc: Triggers the generation of one blank label.

~PH.desc: Triggers the generation of one blank label.

~PL.desc: Increases the length of the label section ejected by the printer during a present cycle.

params.name: length
params.desc: The length of the extra label section to eject, in millimeters. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is 0.

^PM.desc: Configures mirror mode, which mirrors label content across a vertical axis.

params.name: mirror
params.desc: Whether or not to mirror label content. Valid values are Y (mirror label content) and N (do not mirror label content). There is no default value.

params.name: serialNumber
params.desc: The printer serial number. The correct serial number must be used. There is no default value.

params.name: wipeCount
params.desc: The number of times to wipe printer memory. Any number between 0 and 3 may be used. The default value is 0.

^PN.desc: Triggers a present cycle, ejecting a section of the current label.

params.name: length
params.desc: The length of the label section to eject, in millimeters. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. There is no default value.

^PO.desc: Configures inverted mode, which mirrors label content across a horizontal axis.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: Whether or not to invert label content. Valid values are I (invert label content) and N (do not invert label content). The default value is N (do not invert label content).

^PP.desc: Pauses printing until a ~PS command is received.

~PP.desc: Pauses printing until a ~PS command is received.

^PQ.desc: Configures the number of labels generated by a single label definition.

params.name: labels
params.desc: The number of labels generated by the current label definition. Any number between 1 and 99,999,999 may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: labelsBetweenPauses
params.desc: The number of labels between print pauses. Any number between 0 and 99,999,999 may be used. The default value is 0 (no pauses).

params.name: replicates
params.desc: The number of label replicates to generate for each serial number. Any number between 0 and 99,999,999 may be used. The default value is 0 (no replicates).

params.name: noPause
params.desc: Whether or not to prevent printer pauses. Valid values are Y (prevent pauses) and N (do not prevent pauses). The default value is N (do not prevent pauses).

params.name: cutOnError
params.desc: Whether or not to cut the labels after an error label. Valid values are Y (cut after error label) and N (do not cut after error label). The default value is Y (cut after error label).

^PR.desc: Configures the media speed during printing, slew and backfeed.

params.name: printSpeed
params.desc: The print speed, in inches per second. Any number between 1 and 14 may be used. The default value is 2.

params.name: slewSpeed
params.desc: The slew speed, in inches per second. Any number between 1 and 14 may be used. The default value is 6.

params.name: backfeedSpeed
params.desc: The backfeed speed, in inches per second. Any number between 1 and 14 may be used. The default value is 2.

~PR.desc: Triggers a reprint of the last label printed.

~PS.desc: Resumes printing after a printer has been paused via the ~PP command.

params.name: width
params.desc: The label print width, in dots. Any number between 2 and the label width may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or the label width if no value was previously configured.

^RA.desc: Reads the AFI or DSFID byte from the label's RFID tag.

params.name: fieldNumber
params.desc: The field number of the field receiving the read value. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: format
params.desc: The data format to use. Valid values are 0 (ASCII characters) and 1 (hexadecimal digits). The default value is 0 (ASCII characters).

params.name: retries
params.desc: The number of times to retry the read operation, if necessary. Any number between 0 and 10 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: motion
params.desc: The post-read label motion. Valid values are 0 (feed label) and 1 (no feed). The default value is 0 (feed label).

params.name: byteType
params.desc: The type of identifier byte to read. Valid values are A (AFI byte) and D (DSFID byte). The default value is A (AFI byte).

^RB.desc: Configures the RFID EPC data format, including the number of partitions and the partition sizes that are read from and/or written to the RFID tag.

params.name: totalBits
params.desc: The total number of bits across all partitions. Any number between 0 and N may be used, where N is the bit size of the RFID tag. The default value is 96.

params.name: partitions
params.desc: Comma-separated list containing the bit sizes of each partition. Up to 16 partitions may be specified. The sum of all partition sizes must match the total bit size provided in the first parameter. The maximum size of each individual partition is 64 bits. The default value is 1.

^RE.desc: Writes the EAS (Electronic Article Surveillance) bit to the label's RFID tag, if the RFID tag supports EAS. The EAS bit is a theft prevention mechanism used in retail environments.

params.name: enable
params.desc: Whether to enable or disable the EAS bit. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). The default value is N (disable).

params.name: retries
params.desc: The number of times to retry the write operation, if necessary. Any number between 0 and 10 may be used. The default value is 0.

^RF.desc: Reads from the label's RFID tag, writes to the label's RFID tag, or sets the access and kill passwords of the label's RFID tag. When writing data or setting passwords, the actual values are provided in a subsequent ^FD command.

params.name: operation
params.desc: The operation to execute. Valid values are W (write), L (write and lock), R (read), P (read password) and S (set password). The default value is W (write).

params.name: format
params.desc: The data format to use. Valid values are A (ASCII characters), H (hexadecimal digits) and E (EPC partition value list). The default value is H (hexadecimal digits).

params.name: passwordOrBlock
params.desc: A byzantine multi-purpose parameter whose utility varies according to the operation used, the RFID tag type, and the tides. See your printer's documentation for more information.

params.name: bytes
params.desc: The number of bytes to read or write. Any number between 1 and N may be used, where N is the byte size of the RFID tag. The default value is 1.

params.name: memoryBank
params.desc: The memory bank to read from or write to. Valid values are 1 (EPC), 2 (TID), 3 (user), E (EPC 96-bit) and A (EPC with automatic handling of PC bits). The default value is E (EPC 96-bit).

^RI.desc: Reads the 32-bit TID (tag ID) from the label's RFID tag.

params.name: fieldNumber
params.desc: The field number of the field receiving the read TID value. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: order
params.desc: The byte order to apply to the data. Valid values are 0 (default byte order) and 1 (reverse byte order). The default value is 0 (default byte order). Note that different RFID tag manufacturers may use different default byte orders.

params.name: retries
params.desc: The number of times to retry the read operation, if necessary. Any number between 0 and 10 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: motion
params.desc: The post-read label motion. Valid values are 0 (feed label) and 1 (no feed). The default value is 0 (feed label).

^RL.desc: Locks and unlocks the label's RFID tag memory.

params.name: lockAction
params.desc: The lock action to execute. Valid values are B (permanently locks a block of user memory), M (locks or unlocks a password or an entire memory bank, either permanently or temporarily) and P (permanently locks all memory banks and passwords). There is no default value.

params.name: p1
params.desc: For lock action B, sets the starting section of memory to be locked. For lock action M, specifies the action to execute on the kill password, and may be one of L (lock), U (unlock), P (permanently lock) and O (permanently unlock). There is no default value.

params.name: p2
params.desc: For lock action B, sets the number of memory sections to be locked. For lock action M, specifies the action to execute on the access password, and may be one of L (lock), U (unlock), P (permanently lock) and O (permanently unlock). There is no default value.

params.name: epcOp
params.desc: For lock action M, specifies the action to execute on the EPC memory bank, and may be one of L (lock), U (unlock), P (permanently lock) and O (permanently unlock). For other lock actions, this parameter is ignored. There is no default value.

params.name: userOp
params.desc: For lock action M, specifies the action to execute on the user memory bank, and may be one of L (lock), U (unlock), P (permanently lock) and O (permanently unlock). For other lock actions, this parameter is ignored. There is no default value.

^RM.desc: Enables and disables RFID label motion.

params.name: enable
params.desc: Whether to enable or disable RFID label motion. Valid values are Y (enable motion) and N (disable motion). The default value is Y (enable motion).

^RN.desc: Enables and disables detection of multiple RFID tags in the printer's RFID field. When detection is enabled and more than one RFID tag is detected, the label is voided. Disabling detection can speed up the printing process.

params.name: enable
params.desc: Whether to enable or disable multiple RFID tag detection. Valid values are Y (enable detection) and N (disable detection). The default value varies.

params.name: counter
