params.desc: The counter to be reset. Valid values are 1 (label counter 1), 2 (label counter 2), 3 (valid RFID label counter), 4 (voided RFID label counter), C (head cleaned counter) and R (head replaced and head cleaned counters). There is no default value.

^RQ.desc: Quickly writes the EPC data, access password and kill password to the label's RFID tag, using a single write operation. The actual data values are provided in a comma-delimited list in a subsequent ^FD command.

params.name: format
params.desc: The data format to use. Valid values are A (ASCII characters), H (hexadecimal digits) and E (EPC data). The default value is H (hexadecimal digits).

params.name: chipType
params.desc: The RFID tag chip type. There is only one valid value, which is 0 (Alien Higgs chip). The default value is 0 (Alien Higgs chip).

params.name: option
params.desc: Data write options. There is only one valid value, which is 0 (write 96-bit EPC). The default value is 0 (write 96-bit EPC).

^RR.desc: Configures the RFID read/write retry count and read/write failure behavior.

params.name: retries
params.desc: The number of times to retry the read or write operation, if necessary. Any number between 0 and 10 may be used. The default value is 6.

params.name: adaptive
params.desc: Whether or not to try to use the RFID antenna elements near the configured antenna elements in case of read or write failure. Valid values are 0 (do not try neighboring RFID antenna elements) and 1 (try neighboring RFID antenna elements). The default value is 0 (do not try neighboring RFID antenna elements).

^RS.desc: Configures a broad variety of RFID settings.

params.name: type
params.desc: The RFID tag type to expect. Although many different values were supported in the past, the only recommended value today is 8 (EPC Class 1 Gen 2). The default value is 8 (EPC Class 1 Gen 2).

params.name: pos
params.desc: The position of the RFID tag on the label. Valid values are Fn (where n is a number between 0 and 999, and indicates the distance from the leading edge of the label) and Bn (where n is a number between 0 and 30, and indicates the distance backwards from the leading edge of the next label). All values are in millimeters. The default value is F0 (the leading edge of the label).

params.name: voidLen
params.desc: The vertical length of the void label to print when an RFID label fails to read or write, in dots. Any number between 0 and the label height may be used. The default value is the label height.

params.name: labels
params.desc: The maximum number of labels which will be attempted if an RFID read or write operation fails. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value is 3.

params.name: onError
params.desc: The error handling action to execute if the specified number of label attempts fail. Valid values are N (no action), P (pause printer) and E (transition printer to error mode). The default value is N (no action).

params.name: signal
params.desc: The applicator signal mode. Valid values are S (single signal) and D (double signal). The default value is S (single signal).

params.name: deprecated
params.desc: This parameter has been deprecated and is no longer used.

params.name: voidSpeed
params.desc: The speed at which to print the RFID void label, if necessary. Valid values depend on the printer being used. The default value is the printer's maximum print speed.

^RT.desc: Reads data from the label's RFID tag.

params.name: fieldNumber
params.desc: The field number of the field receiving the read data. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: start
params.desc: The first memory block to read. Any number between 0 and N may be used, where N is the number of blocks in the RFID tag. The default value is 0.

params.name: num
params.desc: The number of memory blocks to read. Any number between 1 and N may be used, where N is the number of blocks in the RFID tag. The default value is 1.

params.name: format
params.desc: The data format to use. Valid values are 0 (ASCII characters) and 1 (hexadecimal digits). The default value is 0 (ASCII characters).

params.name: retries
params.desc: The number of times to retry the read operation, if necessary. Any number between 0 and 10 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: motion
params.desc: The post-read label motion. Valid values are 0 (feed label) and 1 (no feed). The default value is 0 (feed label).

params.name: mode
params.desc: A multi-purpose parameter whose utility varies according to the printer and RFID tag type used. Most users can ignore this parameter.

^RU.desc: Reads the TID (tag ID) and EPC data from the label's RFID tag, making it available to be included in label fields by using the specified escape character. Assuming that the default escape character is used, the following data placeholders are made available to be used in ^FD field data: #S (TID in decimal form), #H (TID in hexadecimal form), #E (EPC data with TID in decimal form), #F (EPC data with TID in hexadecimal form), #P (EPC with SGTIN in decimal form) and #Q (EPC with SGTIN in hexadecimal form).

params.name: prefix
params.desc: Prefix to add to the TID when it is read. Must be a binary number of up to 38 digits. The default value is manufacturer-specific.

params.name: escapeChar
params.desc: The escape character to use to include TID or EPC data in field data. Any ASCII character which is not being used as a command delimiter, parameter delimiter or real-time clock (RTC) delimiter may be used. The default value is '#' (hash).

~RV.desc: Enables and disables the sending of RFID encode results to the host computer.

params.name: enable
params.desc: Whether to enable or disable sending of RFID encode results to the host computer. Valid values are E (enable) and D (disable). The default value is D (disable).

^RW.desc: Sets the RFID read and write power levels. Note that this is usually not necessary, as the power levels are normally selected automatically during calibration.

params.name: readPower
params.desc: The read power, in dBm. Any number between 0 and 30 may be used. The default value is 16.

params.name: writePower
params.desc: The write power, in dBm. Any number between 0 and 30 may be used. The default value is 16.

params.name: antennaElement
params.desc: The RFID antenna element to configure. Valid values, as well as the default value, depend on the specific printer model.

^RZ.desc: Sets the label's RFID tag password, and locks or unlocks the RFID tag.

params.name: password
params.desc: The password to use. Any hexadecimal number between 00000000 and FFFFFFFF may be used. The value must be 8 characters long. There is no default value.

params.name: target
params.desc: The action target. Valid values are A (the access password), K (the kill password), E (EPC memory), T (TID memory) and U (user memory). There is no default value.

params.name: action
params.desc: The action to carry out. Valid values are L (lock), U (unlock), P (permanently lock), O (permanently unlock) and W (write). There is no default value.

params.name: baud
params.desc: The baud rate to use, in bits per second. Valid values are 110, 300, 600, 1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 14400, 19200, 28800, 38400, 57600, and 115200. There is no default value.

params.name: wordBits
params.desc: The number of data bits in each character. Valid values are 7 and 8. There is no default value.

params.name: parity
params.desc: The type of parity bit to use for error detection. Valid values are N (none), O (odd), and E (even). There is no default value.

params.name: stopBits
params.desc: The number of stop bits to send after each character. Valid values are 1 and 2. There is no default value.

params.name: mode
params.desc: The flow control mode to use during handshaking. Valid values are X (XON/XOFF), D (DTR/DSR), R (RTS), and M (DTR/DSR XON/XOFF). There is no default value.

params.name: protocol
params.desc: The communication protocol to use. Valid values are A (ACK/NAK), N (none), and Z (reserved). There is no default value.

~SD.desc: Configures the print darkness level. The darkness level can also be modified using the ^MD command.

params.name: darkness
params.desc: The print darkness level. Any number between 0 and 30 may be used. Higher numbers result in darker print output. The default value is the previously configured value.

^SE.desc: Selects a custom encoding table, required by some fonts in order to correctly map characters to glyphs.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to load the encoding table from. The file must use the .DAT extension. There is no default value.

^SF.desc: Configures the current field data to increment automatically. The number of labels (and increments) is controlled by the ^PQ command.

params.name: mask
params.desc: The mask to apply to the field data when determining how to increment it. Must match the starting value specified in the ^FD command. Valid characters are D (representing decimal numbers), H (representing hexadecimal numbers), O (representing octal numbers), A (representing ASCII letters), N (representing alphanumeric ASCII characters), and % (representing ignored characters). There is no default value.

params.name: increment
params.desc: The increment to apply to the field data for each additional label. The default value is 1.

params.name: setting
params.desc: The specific setting to configure. Valid values are 1 (brightness) and 2 (baseline). There is no default value.

params.name: value
params.desc: The intensity value. Any number between 0 and 196 may be used. There is no default value.

^SL.desc: Configures the real-time clock mode and language.

params.name: mode
params.desc: The clock mode. Valid values are S (use time at start of ZPL parsing), T (use time at start of print queueing), or any number between 1 and 999 (use time at last clock tick, using the specified clock resolution, in seconds). The default value is S (use time at start of ZPL parsing).

params.name: language
params.desc: The language to use to localize date/time field data. Valid values are 1 (English), 2 (Spanish), 3 (French), 4 (German), 5 (Italian), 6 (Norwegian), 7 (Portuguese), 8 (Swedish), 9 (Danish), 10 (Spanish), 11 (Dutch), 12 (Finnish), 13 (Japanese), 14 (Korean), 15 (Simplified Chinese), 16 (Traditional Chinese), 17 (Russian), 18 (Polish), 19 (Czech), and 20 (Romanian). The default value is the previously configured value, or the control panel language if no value was previously configured.

^SN.desc: Configures the current field data as a serially-incrementing number. The number of labels (and increments) is controlled by the ^PQ command.

params.name: start
params.desc: The starting number. The default value is 1.

params.name: increment
params.desc: The increment (or decrement) to apply to the field data for each additional label. Any number, positive or negative, containing up to 12 digits, may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: pad
params.desc: Whether or not to pad the numbers with zeroes to match the original start number width. Valid values are Y (pad with zeroes) and N (do not pad with zeroes). The default value is N (do not pad with zeroes).

^SO.desc: Sets the time offset of the secondary or tertiary clock, relative to the primary clock. This command has no effect if the printer does not have a clock. To set the primary clock, use the ^ST command instead.

params.name: clock
params.desc: The clock to modify. Valid values are 2 (secondary) and 3 (tertiary). There is no default value.

params.name: months
params.desc: The months offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: days
params.desc: The days offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: years
params.desc: The years offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: hours
params.desc: The hours offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: minutes
params.desc: The minutes offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: seconds
params.desc: The seconds offset. Any number between -32,000 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

^SP.desc: Starts the printing process for a segment of the label before the full label definition has been processed. This command should only be used on particularly complex labels, and only in particularly time-sensitive scenarios.

params.name: row
params.desc: The dot row number at which to start printing the current label segment. Any number between 0 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is 0.

^SQ.desc: Stops and starts error alerts configured previously with the ^SX command.

params.name: condition
params.desc: The error condition for the alert to stop or start. Valid values are the letters A through W (for individual errors) and * (for all errors). There is no default value. See your printer's documentation for more information about the individual error codes available.

params.name: destination
params.desc: The destination of the alert to stop or start. Valid values are A (serial port), B (parallel port), C (email), D (TCP), E (UDP), F (SNMP) and * (all destinations). There is no default value.

params.name: stop
params.desc: Whether to stop or start the alert. Valid values are Y (stop the alerts) and N (start the alerts). The default value is Y (stop the alerts).

^SR.desc: Sets the printhead resistance. This command should be used with care, as safe limits are hardware-specific. Note that this command is usually not needed in new applications, because printers set the printhead resistance automatically.

params.name: resistance
params.desc: The printhead resistance. Any number between 488 and 1,175 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value.

params.name: web
params.desc: The web sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: media
params.desc: The media sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: ribbon
params.desc: The ribbon sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: length
params.desc: The label length, in dots. Any number between 1 and 32,000 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: int1
params.desc: The media LED intensity. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: int2
params.desc: The ribbon LED intensity. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: sense
params.desc: The black mark sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: mediaSense
params.desc: The media black mark sensor threshold. Any number between 0 and 100 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

params.name: ledSense
params.desc: The black mark sensor LED intensity. Any number between 0 and 255 may be used. The default value is the auto-calibrated value.

^ST.desc: Sets the primary clock date and time, if the printer has a clock.

params.name: month
params.desc: The month. Any number between 1 and 12 may be used. The default value is the current month.

params.name: day
params.desc: The day. Any number between 1 and 31 may be used. The default value is the current day.

params.name: year
params.desc: The year. Any number between 1998 and 2097 may be used. The default value is the current year.

params.name: hour
params.desc: The hour. Any number between 0 and 23 may be used. The default value is the current hour.

params.name: minute
params.desc: The minute. Any number between 0 and 59 may be used. The default value is the current minute.

params.name: second
params.desc: The second. Any number between 0 and 59 may be used. The default value is the current second.

params.name: format
params.desc: The hour format that was used in the fourth parameter. Valid values are A (AM), P (PM) and M (military). The default value is M (military).

^SX.desc: Configures error alerts. Once configured, alerts can be stopped and started by using the ^SQ command.

params.name: condition
params.desc: The error condition for the alert to configure. Valid values are the letters A through W (for individual errors) and * (for all errors). There is no default value. See your printer's documentation for more information about the individual error codes available.

params.name: destination
params.desc: The destination of the alert to configure. Valid values are A (serial port), B (parallel port), C (email), D (TCP), E (UDP) and F (SNMP). There is no default value.

params.name: set
params.desc: Whether or not to alert on set. Valid values are Y (alert on set) and N (do not alert on set). The default value is the previously configured value.

params.name: clear
params.desc: Whether or not to alert on clear. Valid values are Y (alert on clear) and N (do not alert on clear). The default value is the previously configured value.

params.name: setting
params.desc: Destination details, depending on the destination type configured: an email address, or an IP address, or an SNMP trap. There is no default value.

params.name: port
params.desc: Destination port, depending on the destination type configured: a TCP port number, or a UDP port number. There is no default value.

params.name: version
params.desc: The ZPL version. Valid values are 1 (ZPL) and 2 (ZPL II). Use of the value 1 (ZPL) is highly discouraged. The default value is 2 (ZPL II).

params.name: adjustment
params.desc: The tear-off position adjustment, in dots. Any number between -120 and 120 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

^TB.desc: Formats the current field as a text block which wraps text across multiple lines.

params.name: orientation
params.desc: The text block orientation to use. Valid values are N (no rotation), R (rotate 90° clockwise), I (rotate 180° clockwise), and B (rotate 270° clockwise). The default value is the orientation configured via the ^A or ^FW command, which itself defaults to N (no rotation).

params.name: maxWidth
params.desc: The maximum text block width, in dots. Text longer than this width is wrapped to another line. Any number between 1 and the label width may be used. The default value is 1, which is rarely useful.

params.name: maxHeight
params.desc: The maximum text block height, in dots. Any text which exceeds this limit is truncated. Any number between 1 and the label height may be used. The default value is 1, which is rarely useful.

^TO.desc: Copies one or more files in printer memory from one location to another.

params.name: from
params.desc: The file path(s) to copy the file(s) from. Wildcards (*, ?) are accepted. There is no default value.

params.name: to
params.desc: The file path(s) to copy the file(s) to. Wildcards (*, ?) are accepted. There is no default value.

^WA.desc: Configures the wireless antenna used to receive and transmit data.

params.name: receive
params.desc: The antenna used to receive data. Valid values are L (left), R (right) and D (dynamic). The default value is D (dynamic).

params.name: transmit
params.desc: The antenna used to transmit data. Valid values are L (left), R (right) and D (dynamic). The default value is D (dynamic).

^WD.desc: Prints a directory label, listing all files matching the specified path.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path pattern used to search for files to include in the file listing. Wildcards (*, ?) are accepted. The default value is R:*.* which includes all files on the R drive.

^WE.desc: Configures the WEP wireless network security settings. Note that WEP is no longer considered secure, and the ^WX command is generally preferred over this command.

params.name: mode
params.desc: The encryption mode. Valid values are 40 (40-bit encryption), 128 (128-bit encryption) and OFF (no encryption). The default value is OFF (no encryption).

params.name: index
params.desc: The encryption key to use. Any number between 1 and 4 may be used. The default value is 1 (encryption key number 1).

params.name: authType
params.desc: The authentication type to use. Valid values are O (open system) and S (shared key). The default value is O (open system).

params.name: keyType
params.desc: The key type used in the following four parameters. Valid values are H (hexadecimal) and S (alphanumeric string). The default value is H (hexadecimal).

params.name: key1
params.desc: Encryption key number 1. Must be 10 characters if mode is 40, or 26 characters if mode is 128. There is no default value.

params.name: key2
params.desc: Encryption key number 2. Must be 10 characters if mode is 40, or 26 characters if mode is 128. There is no default value.

params.name: key3
params.desc: Encryption key number 3. Must be 10 characters if mode is 40, or 26 characters if mode is 128. There is no default value.

params.name: key4
params.desc: Encryption key number 4. Must be 10 characters if mode is 40, or 26 characters if mode is 128. There is no default value.

^WF.desc: Writes an AFI or DSFID byte to an RFID tag. AFI codes are assigned to specific organizations or functions, and allow for tag selection across the air interface. DSFID codes indicate the expected structure of the data encoded in the RFID tag. The actual byte value encoded is provided in a subsequent ^FD command.

params.name: retries
params.desc: The number of times to retry the write operation, if necessary. Any number between 0 and 10 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: motion
params.desc: The post-write label motion. Valid values are 0 (feed label) and 1 (no feed). The default value is 0 (feed label).

params.name: protect
params.desc: Whether or not to write-protect the data. Valid values are 0 (not protected) and 1 (protected). The default value is 0 (not protected).

params.name: format
params.desc: The data format to expect. Valid values are 0 (one ASCII character) and 1 (two hexadecimal digits). The default value is 0 (one ASCII character).

params.name: type
params.desc: The type of identifier byte to write. Valid values are A (AFI byte) and D (DSFID byte). The default value is A (AFI byte).

^WI.desc: Configures the wireless network settings. Note that the ^ND command should be used instead, if possible.

params.name: res
params.desc: The IP resolver to use. Valid values are A (all), B (BOOTP), C (DHCP and BOOTP), D (DHCP), G (gleaning), R (RARP) and P (permanent). The default value is A (all).

params.name: ip
params.desc: The IP address to use. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: mask
params.desc: The subnet mask to use. Any valid subnet mask in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: gateway
params.desc: The default network gateway. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: wins
params.desc: The WINS server IP address. Any valid IP address in dot-decimal notation may be used. There is no default value.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Whether or not to enable a connection timeout. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). The default value is Y (enable).

params.name: secs
params.desc: The network connection timeout, in seconds. Any number between 0 and 9,999 may be used. The default value is 300.

params.name: arp
params.desc: The ARP broadcast interval, in minutes. Any number between 0 and 30 may be used. The default value is 0 (no ARP broadcast).

params.name: port
params.desc: The port number to use for RAW data. Any number between 1 and 65,535 may be used. The default value is 9100.

^WL.desc: Configures the LEAP wireless network security settings. Note that LEAP is no longer considered secure, and the ^WX command is generally preferred over this command.

params.name: mode
params.desc: Whether or not to enable LEAP. Valid values are ON (enable) and OFF (disable). The default value is OFF (disable).

params.name: username
params.desc: The LEAP username. Up to 32 alphanumeric characters may be used. The default value is 'user'.

params.name: password
params.desc: The LEAP password. Up to 32 alphanumeric characters may be used. The default value is 'password'.

^WP.desc: Sets the four-digit wireless password, which protects wireless settings from being viewed or modified through the control panel. If set to 0000, the protection is disabled.

params.name: oldPassword
params.desc: The old wireless password. Any number between 0000 and 9999 may be used. The default value is 0000.

params.name: newPassword
params.desc: The new wireless password. Any number between 0000 and 9999 may be used. The default value is 0000.

~WQ.desc: Prints a diagnostic label, the content of which depends on the query provided.

params.name: query
params.desc: The type of diagnostic label to print. Valid values are ES (error status), HA (internal wired print server hardware address), JT (printhead test results), MA (maintenance alert settings), MI (maintenance information), OD (odometer), PH (printhead history), PP (plug and play string), SN (serial number) and UI (USB product ID). There is no default value.

^WR.desc: Configures the wireless network transmission rate.

params.name: rate1
params.desc: The 1 Mb/s transmission rate. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). There is no default value.

params.name: rate2
params.desc: The 2 Mb/s transmission rate. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). There is no default value.

params.name: rate55
params.desc: The 5.5 Mb/s transmission rate. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). There is no default value.

params.name: rate11
params.desc: The 11 Mb/s transmission rate. Valid values are Y (enable) and N (disable). There is no default value.

params.name: power
params.desc: The wireless radio transmit power, in mW. Valid values are 1, 5, 20, 30, 50 and 100. There is no default value.

~WR.desc: Resets the wireless radio card and the print server.

params.name: essid
params.desc: The ESSID, or network name. Up to 32 characters may be used. The default value is the previously configured ESSID.

params.name: mode
params.desc: The operating mode. Valid values are I (infrastructure, i.e. connect through a central access point) and A (ad hoc, i.e. peer-to-peer connectivity). The default value is I (infrastructure).

params.name: preamble
params.desc: The preamble size. Valid values are S (short) and L (long). The default value is L (long).

params.name: pulse
params.desc: Enables or disables a wireless pulse, which can sometimes help to keep the printer connected to the network. Valid values are 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled). The default value is 1 (enabled).

params.name: interval
params.desc: The wireless pulse interval in seconds, if the pulse is enabled. Any number between 5 and 300 may be used. The default value is 15.

params.name: mask
params.desc: The channel mask, in hexadecimal 0xHHHH format. The default value is 0x07FF, which is the standard mask for North America. Other regions use other masks (e.g. 0x3FFF in Japan and 0x1FFF in Europe).

params.name: international
params.desc: Whether or not to operate in international mode, where the printer allows the access point to set the channel. Valid values are 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled). The default value is 0 (disabled).

^WT.desc: Writes data to an RFID tag. The actual value encoded is provided in a subsequent ^FD command. Note that use of this command is not encouraged, and the ^RF command is generally preferred over this command.

params.name: block
params.desc: The block number. Any number between 0 and N may be used, where N is the number of blocks in the RFID tag. The default value is 0.

params.name: retries
params.desc: The number of times to retry the write operation, if necessary. Any number between 0 and 10 may be used. The default value is 0.

params.name: motion
params.desc: The post-write label motion. Valid values are 0 (feed label) and 1 (no feed). The default value is 0 (feed label).

params.name: protect
params.desc: Whether or not to write-protect the data. Valid values are 0 (not protected) and 1 (protected). The default value is 0 (not protected).

params.name: format
params.desc: The data format to expect. Valid values are 0 (ASCII characters) and 1 (hexadecimal digits). The default value is 0 (ASCII characters).

params.name: verify
params.desc: Whether or not to verify the RFID tag before writing. Valid values are Y (verify) and N (do not verify). The default value is N (do not verify).

^WV.desc: Configures whether or not to verify the RFID tag before writing to it.

params.name: enable
params.desc: Whether or not to verify the RFID tag before writing to it. Valid values are Y (verify) and N (do not verify). The default value is N (do not verify).

^WX.desc: Configures the wireless network security. Note that WEP (types 02 and 03) and LEAP (types 08 and 14) are no longer considered secure.

params.name: securityType
params.desc: The security type to configure. Valid values are 01 (no wireless security), 02 (40-bit WEP), 03 (128-bit WEP), 04 (EAP-TLS), 05 (EAP-TTLS), 06 (EAP-FAST), 07 (PEAP), 08 (LEAP), 09 (WPA PSK), 10 (WPA EAP-TLS), 11 (WPA EAP-TTLS), 12 (WPA EAP-FAST), 13 (WPA PEAP), 14 (WPA LEAP) and 15 (Kerberos). The default value is 01 (no wireless security).

params.name: parameters
params.desc: A variable number of parameters, depending on the security type chosen. See your printer's documentation for more information.

^XA.desc: Begins a label definition. All label definitions must start with this command.

^XB.desc: Disables forward feed / backfeed after the current label.

^XF.desc: Loads a label definition previously saved via the ^DF command. The ^FN command can then be used to add variable data to previously-defined fields, based on their field numbers.

params.name: path
params.desc: The file path to load the label definition from. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.ZPL.

^XG.desc: Configures the current field as an image graphics field.

params.name: path
params.desc: The path to the image graphics file. The default value is R:UNKNOWN.GRF.

params.name: magnificationX
params.desc: The horizontal magnification to apply to the image. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value is 1.

params.name: magnificationY
params.desc: The vertical magnification to apply to the image. Any number between 1 and 10 may be used. The default value is 1.

^XS.desc: Enables and disables dynamic media calibration.

params.name: length
params.desc: Whether or not to dynamically calibrate label length. Valid values are Y (enable dynamic label length calibration) and N (disable dynamic label length calibration). The default value is Y (enable dynamic label length calibration).

params.name: threshold
params.desc: Whether or not to dynamically calibrate label threshold. Valid values are Y (enable dynamic label threshold calibration) and N (disable dynamic label threshold calibration). The default value is Y (enable dynamic label threshold calibration).

params.name: gain
params.desc: Whether or not to dynamically calibrate label gain. Valid values are Y (enable dynamic label gain calibration) and N (disable dynamic label gain calibration). The default value is Y (enable dynamic label gain calibration).

^XZ.desc: Ends a label definition. All label definitions must end with this command.

^ZZ.desc: Places the printer in sleep mode.

params.name: seconds
params.desc: The number of seconds to wait until shutdown. Any number between 0 and 999,999 may be used. The default value is the previously configured value, or 0 if no value was previously configured.

params.name: immediate
params.desc: Whether or not to sleep immediately. Valid values are Y (sleep immediately, even if labels are still queued for printing) and N (wait until all pending labels have been printed before sleeping). The default value is N (wait until all pending labels have been printed).
